title: 61,000 Bitcoin Found in Britain… Taken from 128,000 People 👑
lines: 61,000 bitcoin. Found in Britain. Taken from 128,000 people in China.
2014 to 2017. A woman in China runs a fake investment scheme.
Police close in. She flees on a fake passport, through Southeast Asia, to the UK.
There, she lives a lavish life. And tries to buy London houses with bitcoin.
That's her mistake. In 2018, a law firm raises the alarm. Police seize the bitcoin. 61,000 coins. A UK record.
Her dream: to become the 'monarch' of a tiny micronation called Liberland.
In 2024, a fast-food worker who helped her gets a small bitcoin transfer. Police are watching. They arrest her in York.
In 2025, she pleads guilty. Her sentence: 11 years and 8 months. Her accomplice gets almost 5 years.
Those coins? Worth almost 5 billion dollars today.

title: He Said 4–5 Weeks. It's Day 247 ⏳
lines: Four to five weeks. That's how long the Iran war was supposed to take. It's been 247 days.
February 28, 2026. US and Israeli strikes hit Iran.
The next day, Trump says: 'We intended four to five weeks.'
March 9: 'Soon. Very soon.' Oil had spiked above 110 dollars. It falls back to the mid-80s.
Bitcoin jumps to 69,000.
April 7: a two-week ceasefire. Bitcoin jumps 2.6 percent in one hour.
June: a deal is 'two or three days' away.
July 8: the ceasefire is 'over.' Bitcoin drops to 62,000.
September: the war 'will end immediately after our election.'
November 1: 'We'll put it away very soon.'
We counted every time on the record. At least 30 times, he said the end was near.
Every time, the market listened. Trump now says those weeks meant the nuclear threat.
Day 247. No final deal.
